after.tests/test_notices.py:
# owner: platform
import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import build_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from datetime import date

STUDENT = Student("s1", "Doe", "Ann", "A")
DAYS = "2026-10-01, 2026-10-05"

def make_mark(day, status, who="s1"):
    return Mark(who, date(2026, 10, day), status)

class BuildNoticeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [make_mark(5, "absent")]
        marks += [make_mark(2, "present")]
        marks += [make_mark(1, "absent")]
        text = build_notice(STUDENT, marks)
        want = "Ann Doe missed 2 day(s): "
        self.assertEqual(text, want + DAYS)

    def test_other_student_raises(self):
        marks = [make_mark(1, "absent", "s2")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_raises(self):
        marks = [make_mark(1, "present")]
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            build_notice(STUDENT, marks)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
